newsitem.title: INDIA: Torrent Cables records $2.8 mln turnover.
newsitem.headline: Torrent Cables records $2.8 mln turnover.

text.p: India's Torrent Cables reported a turnover of 1.01 billion rupees ($2.8 million) in the year 1995/96 (April-March), an increase of 59 percent over the previous year, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.
The company declared a dividend of 22 percent on each share of ten-rupee face value against 20 percent last year.
The firm's chairman, U.N. Mehta, said the company planned to expand its operations and has set a target of 1.30 billion rupees ($3.61 million) for the next financial year.
The company plans to invest in a project to manufacture Extra High Voltage (EHV) cables of up to 132 kv.

Torrent Cables is a part of the energy segment of the Torrent group. The group has a significant presence in the energy segment with an investment in the 24.50 billion rupees Gujarat Torrent Energy Corporation (GTEC).
The GTEC is a 655 mw gas based dual fuel combined cycle power generation plant located at Paguthan in the western Indian state of Gujarat.
